prompt: On a family video call, your grandparent keeps accidentally muting themselves and missing their turn to speak, while a couple of relatives chat over the pauses and the call moves on without them. What response includes your grandparent best?

options.text: Unmute them yourself every time without mentioning it, so the call keeps flowing
Message them afterwards to say it was a shame they were so quiet on the call
Gently pause the chat, talk them through unmuting step by step without rushing, and make space for them to finish their news before the conversation moves on
Suggest they just listen in future and let everyone else do the talking

explanation: Slowing down for a minute and guiding them through the button, then protecting their turn to speak, keeps your grandparent a real part of the family call instead of an audience for it.
